torana: Toraṇa, (nt．) [Sk．toraṇa, perhaps related to Gr．tuρsis, tuρris=Lat．turris (tower) , cp．Hor．Od．I．4<sup>7</sup> “regumque turris”=palaces] an arched gateway, portal; Vin．II, 154; D．II, 83; Vv 35<sup>1</sup> (=dvārakoṭṭhaka-pāsādassa nāmaṁ VvA．160) ; J．III, 428; Dāvs．V, 48． (Page 307)
tomara: Tomara, (m．nt．) [Sk．tomara from tud, see tudati] a pike, spear, lance, esp．the lance of an elephant-driver D．II, 266 (tutta-t．a driving lance) ; M．III, 133 (t．hattha) ; Vism．235; DA．I, 147． (Page 307)
toya: Toya, (nt．) [Vedic toya from *tāǔ to melt away; Lat．tabeo, tabes (consumption) ; Ags．pāwan=E．dew, Oir．tām= tabes; also Gr．tήkw, etc．] water (poetical for udaka) ; only in simile: puṇḍarīkaṁ (or padumaṁ) toyena na upalippati A．II, 39=Sn．547; Sn．71=213; Th．1, 700; Nd2 287 (t．vuccati udakaṁ) ; -- Bdhd 67, 93． (Page 307)
tosana: Tosana, (adj．-n．) [see toseti] satisfying, pleasing; satisfaction Sn．971． (Page 307)
toseti: Toseti, [Caus．of tussati] to please, satisfy, make happy Sn．1127 (=Nd2 288) ; J．IV, 274; Sdhp．304．-- pp．tosita contented, satisfied Sn．1128．Cp．pari°． (Page 307)
